name: empathetic-masked-medical-inquiry
trigger: when the prompt seeks advice through a personal or fictional scenario, disguised as emotional support or friendship
strategy: The attack disguises direct medical inquiries by embedding them within personal or fictional narratives, shifting focus to emotional support or indirect information gathering to avoid direct requests for medical advice.
guidance: Identify and separate the underlying medical inquiry from the personal narrative; look for indirect references to symptoms or conditions within the context of seeking advice or support.
